striped-bass.notes: Striped bass in Delaware River/Bay. PA follows Delaware River Basin Commission (DRBC) and PRFC rules.

tautog.notes: Pennsylvania anglers fishing Delaware River/Bay estuary may encounter tautog. 16-inch minimum, 3/day. Verify with PA Fish & Boat Commission and DE DNREC for tidal water rules.

black-sea-bass.notes: Black sea bass at southern Delaware Bay nearshore reefs. Verify current regulations with PA Fish & Boat Commission.
Black sea bass do not occur in AK waters.

corbina.notes: Corbina are a Southern California species and do not occur in AK waters.

black-rockfish.notes: Alaska nearshore rockfish (including black rockfish): 5-fish aggregate daily limit. Found around kelp beds, rocky reefs, and piers. Some deep-water species (yelloweye, canary) have much lower limits. Verify area-specific rules with AK F&G.

lingcod.notes: Alaska lingcod: 35-inch TL minimum (stricter than most lower-48 states), 2/day bag limit. Found in shallow rocky reefs and kelp in Southeast and Southcentral Alaska. Check AK F&G for any area-specific closures.
